newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' forex deposits up at $14.45 bln in 96.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' forex deposits up at $14.45 bln in 96.

text.p: Philippine banks' foreign exchange deposits rose by 53 percent to a record $14.451 billion at the end of 1996 from the year-ago $9.430 billion, the Central Bank reported on Friday.
These deposits are not officially counted as part of the country's international reserves but they represent a second layer of foreign reserves, the Central Bank said.
The forex deposits come from exporters, local companies with dollar earnings and families of overseas Filipinos.
The Philippines ended 1996 with gross international reserves at a record $11.84 billion, up from $7.7 billion in 1995, the Central Bank said.
